newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher, bouncing off strong Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher, bouncing off strong Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened higher on Tuesday, recharged by a Dow surge overnight, brokers said. They added that gains were likely to be fairly limited as market participants are waiting for September futures and options to expire later this week before taking new positions.
At 0012 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was up 175.34 points or 0.87 percent at 20,377.61. Its December futures were up 130 points at 20,360.
"The Nikkei is eyeing the 20,500 level but selling pressure sets in every time it draws near, capping the gains," one broker said.
